objective: Deliver tests that pass the correct order service and detect all privately seeded behavioral regressions.

tasks.title: Protect order lifecycle behavior
tasks.description: Create a useful regression suite for the public payment/refund state machine; a comprehensive suite may finish the whole job.
tasks.requirements: Submit tests/test_regression.py using unittest and public Order methods. It must pass the correct implementation and detect a behavioral fault. Follow README capability restrictions.

tasks.title: Add refund boundary coverage
tasks.description: Contribute additional executable refund regression coverage; coverage already supplied by other receipts is not counted twice.
tasks.requirements: Submit tests/test_refunds.py. Correct-implementation pass and independent fault detection are required.

tasks.title: Provide behavioral examples
tasks.description: Provide checked sequences and expected outcomes that help a test author reason about order transitions.
tasks.requirements: Submit the README scenarios JSON schema. Evidence does not itself count as executable regression coverage.

analysis.assembly: trusted caller-supplied artifact assembler with independent final grading
